about_the_game:
ANIWARS is a strategic turn-based roguelike where you play as a faction Commander. Lead your squad, collect powerful items, conquer territory and face off against the other powerful rival Commanders!

INNOVATIVE STRATEGIC COMBAT

Battle through difficult encounters where you must use everything at your disposal to prevail against the enemy, be it unique abilities, using the environment to your advantage, capturing objectives or finding the perfect use for the item you picked up earlier.

STORY & FACTIONS

For over half a century, the world has been engulfed in an unending conflict. It all started after Void Day, a cataclysmic event where all of Vertex’s Dark Matter drives around the globe imploded creating Void Zones which swallowed cities and ripped apart continents. From the chaos three factions emerged: the Military, PUNKZ and Vertex. Each faction has its own style in both design and gameplay.

THE COMMANDERS

Commanders function both as playable characters and bosses! Every Commander has their own story, unique evolving dialogue and a key role in uncovering the secrets and conspiracies of ANIWARS.

CONQUER THE MAP

Capture territory, gather resources and gain enough power to challenge the rival Commander at the end. In each run you will make your way through multiple maps, with increasing difficulty.

INFINITE REPLAYABILITY!

Over 150 items & consumables with wild combos, dozens of events & encounters, the unit trait system and mercenaries make each run of ANIWARS a unique experience! And this is just for the Early Access release, there is more to come.

UPCOMING CONTENT

  • The Wasteland Biome

  • The Arctic Biome

  • More Items & Events

  • The faction-neutral Mercenary Unit

  • Unlockable Items, Achievements & Challenge Modes

  • Void Faction: 4 units & 2 Commanders

  • A secret unlockable Commander

  • The Completed ANIWARS story, including all Commanders’ personal stories
